title: Marugame Udon
summary: MENAARC delivered the fit-out of Marugame Udon at Deira City Center, a restaurant shaped around the brand’s Japanese dining experience. Custom joinery, finishes, lighting and layout planning support a functional kitchen, smooth operations and a comfortable setting for guests.

approval.note: Client confirmed MENAARC holds the rights to present this project. Source archive: righteousgrp.com.
